answer: Require every agent to lock a timber bond that grows only through verified work: each epoch the bond adds one ring, like a tree, and only mature rings count toward reputation. A newcomer can still join, but its influence starts as a thin plume, rising slowly as rings accumulate. To claim a reward, the agent must also publish a short sonnet-length proof of its work, checked against the public ledger, so a sybil operator pays the full bond, time and proof cost for every fake identity instead of cloning one for free.
